CustomField.description: The dollar change against the prior bill expressed as a percentage of that prior bill. Pairs with the absolute figure so that a small bill doubling and a large bill moving a few percent can be told apart during the monthly review.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Percentage change against last month total charges. Blank on a first bill, and blank where last month total was zero, because a percentage change from zero has no meaning.
CustomField.label: Total Variance Percent
